product.title: Key West Ultimate Watersports Adventure with Snorkeling Upgrade

description.text: Enjoy an amazing day out on the water in Florida’s Key West with this ultimate adventure tour aboard a catamaran. Spend the day partaking in water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, snorkeling, and riding on a Banana Boat. Sunbathe on the boat’s spacious deck, or just take in the sights of the Key West area. Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
